payload.author: coordinator
evidence: Pinned clear 0x462870 writes its index at 0x46287C and (index == 0) activity at 0x4628AF; init 0x470A90 writes activity 1 at 0x470AB1. PlanWin init assigns index 1 and calls clear(1); WorldWin also assigns logical index 1. Startup independently allocates MapWinTable entries 1..7 and publishes ConsoleGlobal at slot 0.

game_io 0x5A6890 transfers exactly six existing 32-bit words in index, activity, +1DD70, +1DD98, +1DD9C, +1DDA0 order. The semantic names do not assert original debug identifiers, full class identity or complete lifetime proof.
payload.hypothesis: MapWin words +1DD74 and +1DD78 represent view activity and a logical map-view index, not proof of membership in MapWinTable.
